branches.suggestion: Oh, you poor thing. You've got a cold? You should have some chicken soup.
branches.suggestionFa: آخی، بیچاره. سرما خوردی؟ باید سوپ مرغ بخوری.

branches.suggestion: It always helps! And you shouldn't go out in the rain.
branches.suggestionFa: همیشه کمک می‌کنه! و نباید زیر بارون بیرون بری.

r3.speaker: mehdi
r3.text: But I need to go to work.

branches.suggestion: Work can wait, dear. You should rest. What do people do for a cold in your country?
branches.suggestionFa: کار می‌تونه صبر کنه عزیزم. باید استراحت کنی. تو کشور تو برای سرماخوردگی چی کار می‌کنن؟

r4.speaker: mehdi
r4.text: We drink hot tea with ginger.

branches.suggestion: Lovely! Ginger is very good. And you should go to bed early.
branches.suggestionFa: چه خوب! زنجبیل خیلی خوبه. و باید زود بخوابی.

branches.suggestion: Ask the chemist, dear. They're very helpful. You shouldn't take too much.
branches.suggestionFa: از داروخونه بپرس عزیزم. خیلی کمک می‌کنن. نباید زیاد بخوری.

branches.suggestion: Here's your soup. Eat it all up! You'll be right as rain in no time.
branches.suggestionFa: اینم سوپت. همه‌اش را بخور! زود سرحال می‌شی.

r7.speaker: mehdi
r7.text: Thanks, Nana Weda! See you later.
